description: This file defines the PHP class 'Twig' within the 'Opencart\System\Library\Template' namespace. It provides methods to initialize Twig templates, add template paths, and render templates with data, serving as a wrapper around the Twig templating engine for the OpenCart framework.

classes.name: Twig
classes.description: A wrapper class for the Twig templating engine, managing template loading, path addition, and rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Twig wrapper, setting the web root directory and the base directory for templates.

methods.name: addPath
methods.description: Adds a namespace and directory path for templates, allowing for organized template location management.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a template file with provided data, supporting inline template code and managing internal Twig environment setup.
